items.summary: Financial recommendation: hold new discretionary spend and new implementation admissions. Revenue evidence is insufficient for investment claims: Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but all $4.92 is in an aggregate unattributed row; site-attributed income is $0. Contribution margin, ROI, and revenue forecast are not calculable because infrastructure, domains, labor, and other direct costs are absent, and revenue data is stale as of 2026-09-21. AI spend is $2.2785467 on 16 calls across only 4 instrumented sites; fleet-wide AI cost is unknown because 4 of 38 expected sites are observed. Preserve existing measurement and attribution gates, and do not fund the proposed control-plane build until its avoided-cost or revenue benefit is measured.

Financial gate: do not admit the proposed execution control-plane work as funded implementation while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and its financial return is unquantified. If capacity is later released, use existing control-plane telemetry to produce a report-only baseline of duplicate requests, approval-to-execution delay, failed-request rework, and operator time; no new telemetry or production mutation is authorized by CFO.
